notes: • Newstime: news now comes from 1,107 outlets worldwide. Tap a country on the News map, then "From France's press" (or that country's) to see what its own outlets cover most; on Sources, browse any country's most-read outlets, ranked, with a short note on why each ranks where it does. The feed can also rank stories by how many outlets or how many articles cover them.

• Dispatch: creating a new top-level project on a board that has a shared board mounted now asks "Where should it go?" — add it to the shared board (it syncs to your other devices and collaborators) or keep it on this device only. Local-only projects show a small "Local only" label. Projects stranded outside the shared board by earlier versions are picked up and synced within a couple of seconds of signing in. Viewers and commenters are not offered the shared board.

• NEW: Pine Composer — build TradingView Pine Script indicators from blocks you switch on and off, preview them on demo data, and copy the script. Stack layers (gold or inflation overlays, rolling regression channels), reorder, rename or colour them, or describe the view you want in a sentence and get a suggested setup. Works offline.

• NEW: Ideas — a place for notes that link together. Nest pages inside pages, link them with [[double brackets]] and see what links back, view a page as text, bubbles or a diagram, and open a graph of everything connected. Tap + to capture a thought in a second.

• NEW (Alpha): Stories — keep a novel, cartoon or film as a story: write each scene's script, sketch a rough storyboard panel by panel, and keep notes on characters, places and beats. Turning rough figures into finished drawings comes later; it is not in this Alpha.

• Wikipick is much snappier: opening a saved article, searching and background saving no longer stall as your library grows. Undo now covers your own edits only — background saving clears it, so Undo no longer steps back through pages being downloaded.

• Applet settings now open in one Settings window from the ⋮ menu instead of crowding the menu itself. In Wikipick it holds Download over Wi-Fi only, Auto-save linked pages, the app's language, your library size and a link to Saving offline. Changing the language there switches the window and the app right away.

• Bodytomy: one selection window — search muscles, add them with +, reorder them, focus the camera on all of them at once, and isolate what
